name: recognition_benchmark
purpose: Real-page benchmark for Module 1 part B (OCR, text layer, tables, title blocks, key fields). Defines pages, regions and ground truth; results and method in 96_recognition_real_data.md.

groups.A: vector pages with a text layer (GT = text layer, rendered and OCR'd)
groups.B: real raster scans (GT = hand transcription, lines + excluded zones)
groups.D: text drawn as vector outlines (GT = hand transcription or title-block key fields)

metric.character_accuracy: 1 - (edits + deletions) / N_gt, Unicode NFC. 'strict': whitespace removed on both sides (CAD text layers have unreliable spacing), no case folding, no homoglyph folding. 'relaxed': + dash unification and Latin->Cyrillic homoglyph folding. 'relaxed_ci': + case folding. Insertions (OCR text with no GT) reported separately.
metric.alignment_text_layer: each GT glyph is assigned to the OCR line polygon containing its centre (pad 0.25 line height; nearest by outside-distance, then minor-axis offset); per line Levenshtein(GT glyphs in reading order, OCR text). Reading-order and segmentation independent.
metric.alignment_scans: per GT line: min semi-global edit distance against any overlapping OCR line or the x-ordered concatenation of same-row OCR lines. GT lines whose centre lies in an excluded zone (seal, stamp, QR, handwriting, overlay) are not scored.
metric.acceptance_threshold: OCR lines with score < 0.5 count as not returned (deletions).
metric.key_field_em: exact match of the GT token inside the OCR text of lines overlapping the GT field box (±0.5 line height); NFC + whitespace collapse; strict case; word boundaries enforced (numeric tokens may be followed by a unit letter); 'relaxed' adds homoglyph folding.
metric.ci: bootstrap over pages/regions (2000-4000 resamples), weighted by N_gt

results_summary_2026_09_27.note: Measured on an M2 Max under load from other agents; details and caveats in 96_recognition_real_data.md §3, §10.

provenance: Copied from docs/analysis/recognition_benchmark.json v0.1 (analysis phase, 96) by AG-02A for the inspector-batch bench command. Group R (hidden-test pages, speed/format profiling only) is removed: the hidden object must not be referenced from code or config (make guard). Hand GT unchanged. v0.3 (AG-02A, M1): GT v2 integrated (ocr_gt_v2.json copied verbatim, sha256 in gt_sets.v2), pages N01/N02 added from the manifest, key_fields_v2 added; v1 hand_gt and key_fields unchanged.

v1.note: 2026-09-27 analysis-agent transcriptions (96 §1.2); kept unchanged to reproduce the M0 numbers. Superseded by v2 (see ocr_gt_v2.json old_gt_corrections).

v2.method: 2 independent visual transcriptions + visual adjudication; no OCR/text layer
v2.scoring_rule: score every line except exclude_from_scoring=true. excluded_zones are graphics masks (seal, signature, handwriting, QR) for OCR insertions; do not drop lines by centre-in-zone, because several legible printed lines (flag centre_in_excluded_zone) sit under seals/signatures on B01/B05/B06/B08
v2.note: Two independent visual transcriptions + adjudication (14 pages, 46,987 chars). Metric rules (bench/metrics.py score_line_gt_v2): every line scored except exclude_from_scoring; GT lines are not dropped by zone; excluded zones only mask OCR insertions; visually undecidable glyphs folded in every mode (ø family; multiplication sign between digits). key_fields_v2: v1 fields with B04 «ВСС-1а» → «БСС-1а» plus fields of B03, B05, B08, N01 read off the GT text (N02 is pixel-identical to N01 except the QR, so it has no separate key fields).
